source: 745 Three Items
target: 745 Tres Res

source: Having checked his physical condition, Lumian slowly moved along the wall of the spacious corridor.
target: Corpus suum inspectum habens, Lumian lente iuxta parietem porticæ spatiosæ ambulavit.

source: During this, he almost cleared his mind, not thinking or analyzing, focusing solely on whether he would be caught by the silver full‐length mirror at the end of the deep corridor.
target: Interea, fere mentem evacuavit, nihil cogitans nec ratiocinans, solum intendens utrum a speculo argenteo integerrimo, in extremo porticæ profundae, caperetur.

source: Finally, following his instincts, Lumian stopped.
target: Denique, instinctu ductus, Lumian sistit.

source: He hoped to use the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence and a Fate Appropriator’s sensitivity to fate to find the most “suitable” room among the doors of starlight.
target: Sperabat legem Convergence Characteristicarum Beyonder ac sensum Fati Appropriatoris ad fatum adhibere, ut cameram maxime aptam inter portas stellarum inveniret.

source: There might be high-level items from the Hunter’s path there, even the main ingredient for the Iron‐blooded Knight potion!
target: Illic fortasse erunt res excelsae ex itinere Venatoris, etiam elementum principale potioni Eques Sanguine Ferreo.

source: Looking at the translucent door formed by brilliant starlight beside him, Lumian, in a hushed tone, asked, “Termiboros, do you think there’s great danger inside?”
target: Intuens ad ianuam translucidam, a splendore stellarum praeclaro formatam iuxta se, Lumian submisse rogavit: “Termiboros, putasne magnum periculum intus esse?”

source: After the ordeal with the School of Truth, Lumian grew more cautious and vigilant towards the Angel of Inevitability, but that didn’t mean he wouldn’t seek His opinion under the right circumstances and conditions, as Termiboros could still offer valuable advice.
target: Post perniciem cum Schola Veritatis, Lumian cautior et vigilantius erga Angelum Inevitabilitatis factus est, sed id non significabat eum opinionem Eius non quaesiturum; nam Termiboros adhuc praeclaram consilium offerre poterat.

source: As it was now, with Madam Magician outside, Termiboros had little hope of breaking His seal; his death or mutation would only worsen His situation, likely prompting Him to warn of any danger.
target: Nunc, cum Magistra Magica foris esset, Termiboros paullo spem habebat sigillum Eius rumpendi; mors eius aut mutatio tantum rem Eius inpeioraret, verisimiliter eum ad pericula monenda incitans.

source: Lumian couldn’t see changes in his own fate, but Termiboros could!
target: Lumian eiusdem fati mutationes videre non potuit, sed Termiboros poterat!

source: Termiboros remained silent, not answering Lumian’s question.
target: Termiboros silentium retinuit, nec rogationi Lumiani respondit.

source: Unfazed, Lumian placed his right hand, still pulsing with the Blood Emperor’s residual essence, on the handle of the starlight door before him.
target: Imperturbatus, Lumian dextram manum, adhuc vibrare reliqua essentia Imperatoris Sanguinis sentiens, in manubrio ianuae stellarum ante se collocavit.

source: He slowly turned the handle, poised to push the door open, waiting for any reaction from Termiboros.
target: Manubrium lente vertere coepit, paratus ianuam aperire, exspectans cuiuslibet reactionis ab Termiboro.

source: The door of starlight gradually opened, and Termiboros gave no warning.
target: Ianua stellarum gradatim patefacta est, nec Termiboros ullam monitionem attulit.

source: No response is also a response! It means the danger inside is bearable, or likely manageable…
target: Nulla responsio quoque responsum est! Id significat periculum intus tolerabile esse, aut verisimiliter regendum…

source: Lumian calmly pushed the door wide open and walked into the room dominated by shadows.
target: Lumian placide ianuam late patefecit et in cameram, umbris dominantem, ingressus est.

source: Suddenly, a bluish‐white blaze lit up, and an iron‐black sword engulfed in terrifying flames struck down towards his head.
target: Subito, ignis caeruleo‐albus refulsit, ac gladius nigro‐ferreus, ignibus terribilibus circumdatus, in caput eius impetum fecit.

source: Prepared for such surprises, Lumian quickly activated the black mark on his shoulder and teleported to the side of the room.
target: Paratus talibus inopinatis eventibus, Lumian celeriter signum nigrum in umero suo activavit et ad latus camerae se teleportavit.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: The black sword, covered in bluish‐white flames, struck the translucent starlight floor, leaving a deep crack.
target: Gladius niger, flammis caeruleo‐albis indutus, pavimentum stellarum translucidum percussit, relinquens fissuram profundam.

source: Inside the crack, some of the starlight melted, appearing like flowing magma.
target: In fissura, aliqua lumen stellarum liquefactum est, quasi magma effluens apparens.

source: Using the sparks, Lumian saw who his assailant was.
target: Scintillis utens, Lumian vidit quis esset aggressor eius.

source: It was a nearly 2.5‑meter tall suit of iron‐black armor, the interior of its visor a swath of darkness, as if uninhabited, with no fiery glow of an undead’s eyes.
target: Erat armatura nigrum‐ferrea, prope 2.5 metra alta, cuius interior visori latum atri tenebras patefecit, quasi desertum, sine ullo igneo fulgore oculorum inferorum.

source: With a swift motion, the iron‐black armor turned and faced Lumian, raising the large sword covered in bluish‐white flames once more.
target: Celeriter motu, armatura nigro‐ferrea se vertit et Lumian obviam profectus est, iterum elevans magnum gladium, flammis caeruleo‐albis indutum.

source: Before it could strike, Lumian’s blue eyes had turned iron‐black.
target: Ante ictum, oculi caerulei Lumiani in nigrum‐ferreos conversi erant.

source: He spotted the weak points in the half‑giant armor, the pale‑white spots at its joints.
target: Animadvertit puncta debilia in armatura semi‑gigantis, et maculas pallide‑albas in juncturis eius.

source: As the black sword struck with its fiery blade, Lumian teleported away again.
target: Dum gladium niger ictu igneo percutit, Lumian iterum se teleportavit.

source: With a bang, the bluish‑white flames scattered, and Lumian’s figure outlined behind the iron‑black armor.
target: Cum “Pum!” resonavit, flammae caeruleo‑albae dispersae sunt, et figura Lumiani post armaturam nigro‑ferream delineata est.

source: He leaped up, his right fist igniting with white flames.
target: Saltavit, dextera pugna eius igni albo inflammata.

source: A resounding clang echoed as Lumian punched the joint between the helmet and body armor of the iron‑black armor.
target: Resonans clangor auditus est, dum Lumian juncturam inter galeam et loricam armaturae nigro‑ferrea percussit.

source: Cull!
target: Cull!

source: After landing the punch, Lumian immediately teleported away, dodging a waist‑high slash from the half‑turned iron‑black armor.
target: Post ictum traditum, Lumian statim se teleportavit, vitans ictum ad altitudinem lumbi a semi‑versa armatura nigro‑ferrea.

source: In this manner, using the high mobility of teleport, he continuously appeared behind his target, striking the same spot with Cull, never overreaching, completing a single hit with each teleport.
target: Hac re, alta mobilitate teleportationis usus, continue post scopum suum apparuit, eundem punctum cum “Cull” percutiens, numquam ultra procedens, unum ictum per singulam teleportationem conficiens.

source: Clang! Clang! Clang!
target: Clang! Clang! Clang!

source: After five consecutive Culls, the iron‑black armor stood frozen in place.
target: Post quinque consecutivos “Cull”, armatura nigro‑ferrea in loco immota stetit.

source: Gnarly cracks spread rapidly from the joint between its helmet and body armor, soon covering its entire body.
target: Fissurae sinistrae celeriter e junctura inter galeam et loricam se pervagabant, mox totum corpus tegentes.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: The iron‑black armor completely shattered, its metal fragments falling like rain onto the starlight‑condensed floor, making a pattering sound.
target: Armatura nigro‑ferrea omnino dissipata est, fragmenta eius metallorum, quasi pluvia, in solum stellarum condensatum cadentes, strepitum facientes.

source: Clang. The large sword covered in bluish‑white flames followed, hitting the ground.
target: Clang. Magnum gladium, flammis caeruleo‑albis indutum, subsecutus est, terram percutiens.

source: It has no intelligence, moves stiffly, and is stronger than a Sequence 6 but weaker than a Sequence 5.
target: Non habet intelligentiam, agit rigidum, et est fortius quam Series VI sed infirmius quam Series V.

source: However, that sword hits incredibly hard.
target: Attamen hic gladium perquam vehemens ictum dat.

source: If it struck me, unless I substituted with an animated shadow, I would’ve been killed instantly or lost limbs.
target: Si mihi illud percuteret, nisi umbram animatam substituissem, statim interfectus essem aut membra amitterem.

source: That’s only because it didn’t hit my torso.
target: Hoc tantum, quod non me percussit in pecto.

source: And yes, it’s very durable, even more so than the Guardians I encountered at the Dream Festival, Lumian mused, glancing at the shattered armor while using the remaining light from the black sword to scan the room for other dangers.
target: Et quidem, valde durabile est, etiam super custodes quos in Festival Somniorum conveneram; Lumian meditabatur, aspexit armaturam confractam, dum reliquam lucem ex gladio nigro ad pericula in camera exploranda adhibebat.

source: The room was quite empty, featuring only an altar‑like stone platform with a small, transparent glass bottle on it, containing a semi‑solid yellowish‑red substance, topped with a thick black wick.
target: Camera erat satis vacua, habens solum suggestum lapideum altaris simile, in quo parva, perspicua vitrea lagena sita erat, quae substantiam semi‑solidam luteo‑rubram continens, coronatam crassa nigra mebula.

source: A mystical candle? Lumian speculated roughly.
target: Candela mystica? Lumian ruditer coniecerat.

source: I wonder what it’s used for…
target: Miror ad quid hoc adhiberi possit…

source: By now, he was fairly certain there were no other surprises, and he turned his attention back to the pile of fragments from the shattered iron‑black armor.
target: Iam satis certus erat nullas alias miracula exspectanda esse, atque animos redeunxit ad congeriem fragmentorum armaturae nigro‑ferreae confractae.

source: Among the debris, he found a peculiar piece of leather.
target: Inter ruinas, invenit fragmentum cori insolitum.

source: The leather was about the size of half a towel, creamy white, and finely textured, appearing so enticing that even from a distance, Lumian felt it must have belonged to a beautiful woman.
target: Corium, circa dimidiam linteae quantitatem, cremosum et subtili textura, tam venustum apparens ut etiam a longinquo Lumian sensit id pulchrae feminae pertinuisse. skin? he muttered, frowning as he approached.

source: He didn’t immediately pick up the black sword, whose flames had mostly died down, or the alluring piece of leather.
target: Non statim sustulit gladium nigrum, cuius flammae paene exstinxerant, neque particulam cori amoenam.

source: Instead, he drew a dagger from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Proinde, ex sacculo Viatoris, pugionem extraxit.

source: Using the dagger, Lumian picked out the leather, holding it up before him.
target: Pugione utendo, Lumian corium elegit et ante se sustulit.

source: The first thing he saw was a few words in ancient Hermes script:
target: Primum quod vidit, pauca verba in antiqua scriptura Hermes notata:

source: “Despair…
target: “Desperatio…

source: “Sequence 4…”
target: “Series IV…”

source: Suddenly, Lumian’s breathing grew belabored, his head spun, and his physical condition visibly worsened.
target: Subito, respiratio Lumiani laboriosa facta est, caput eius vertit, et eius conditio corporalis palam peior facta est.

source: He quickly looked away and used the dagger to lift the delicate white leather, stuffing it into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Celeriter oculos avertit et, pugione utendo, delicatum album corium elevavit atque in sacculo Viatoris suo reponit.

source: His discomfort gradually subsided.
target: Molestia eius paulatim cessavit.

source: A potion formula for the Demoness of Despair? Lumian mused over what he had just seen.
target: Formula poculi pro Daemona Desperationis? Lumian de ea re, quae modo visa fuerat, meditatus est.

source: And the leather it’s written on was peeled right off a Demoness of Despair, hence its special and dangerous nature? Truly a relic from the Tudor dynasty, harboring such items…
target: Et corium, in quo scriptum erat, ex Daemona Desperationis depulsum erat, ideo naturam peculiarem et periculosam habens? Vere relicta est ex dynastia Tudor, talia continens…

source: Lost in thought, Lumian’s gaze shifted to the black sword, whose bluish‑white flame was dimming, no longer as brilliant as before.
target: Absorptus cogitatione, oculus Lumiani ad gladium nigrum convertebat, cuius flamma caeruleo‑alba paulatim extinguebatur, non iam tam nitens quam prius.

source: He pondered for a moment, deciding not to risk determining the item’s abilities, effects, and negative impacts just yet.
target: Aliquem momenti suspensus, decrevit non periculum capere ad determinandas proprietates, effectus, et detrimenta rei modo.

source: Instead, he placed it into the Traveler’s Bag, setting it aside in a corner clear of other items.
target: Proinde, illud in sacculo Viatoris reponit, in angulo extra alias res separatum.

source: Using the same method, Lumian also packed the strange candle in the glass bottle into the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Eodem modo, Lumian candela mirabilis in lagena vitrea posita quoque in sacculo Viatoris reponit.

source: He planned to consult Madam Magician about these items once outside, rather than experimenting on his own!
target: Consilium habebat ut, semel extra, cum Magistra Magica de his rebus consuleret, potius quam solus experimenta faceret!

source: After ensuring the room had nothing else of interest, Lumian returned through the door of starlight to the deep, spacious corridor.
target: Postquam certus fuit camera nihil aliud praestare, Lumian per ianuam stellarum in profundum et spatiosum porticum rediit.

source: Just as he was about to continue using the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence and a Fate Appropriator’s sensitivity to fate to choose the next room to explore, a faint, distant voice suddenly echoed in his ears: “For you, the other rooms are too dangerous…”
target: Iam ut legem Convergence Characteristicarum Beyonder et sensum Fati Appropriatoris ad fatum eligendum uteretur, ut proximam cameram explorandam eligeret, vox tenue procul atque subito in auribus eius resonavit: “Tibi, ceterae camerae nimis periculosae sunt…”

source: This was the voice of Madam Magician.
target: Haec vox Magistrae Magicae fuit.

source: Mr. Hanged Man and her are indeed watching… Did her words mean that the exploration is to pause here? This confirmation steadied Lumian considerably.
target: Dominus Hanged Man et ipsa revera observabant… Num verba eius indicabant explorationem hic sistere? Haec confirmatio Lumian admodum stabilivit.

source: He thought for a few seconds, deciding to do one more thing before leaving this extradimensional space.
target: Paucos secundos cogitavit, decidens unum adhuc facere antequam hanc spatiam extradimensionalem relinqueret.

source: Slowly, bit by bit, he circled towards the silver full‐length mirror at the end of the corridor, his focus intense, ready to turn and leave at the first word of discouragement from Madam Magician.
target: Lente, paulatim, circumstetit ad speculum argenteum totum in longitudine, in fine corridoris, cum studio intenso, paratus ut verteret et discederet ad primum verbum demotivationis a Magistra Magica.

source: Until he reached the side of the silver full‑length mirror, Madam Magician had not spoken out to stop him.
target: Donec ad latus speculi argentei totius longitudinis pervenisset, Magistra Magica nondum locuta erat ut eum sisteret.

source: Lumian took a deep breath and carefully moved his right palm towards the front of the silver full‑length mirror.
target: Lumian alium spiritum traxit et curanter dextram palmam suam versus frontem speculi argentei plenae longitudinis movit.

source: He didn’t know whether the mirror would react again when reflecting only a palm.
target: Nescivit utrum speculum iterum reagere vellet, si tantum palmam reflecteret.

source: As his palm moved slowly, Lumian’s nerves were taut.
target: Dum palmas eius lente moveret, nervi Lumiani stricti erant.

source: Finally, he touched the surface of the mirror, feeling its brittle yet firm coldness.
target: Denique superficiem speculi attigit, frigiditatem eius, quamquam fragili sed firma, sentiens.

source: Immediately after, Lumian activated a power from his contract with Bloody Jack—Mirror Markl He wanted to test whether he could still sense the mark left in this hidden space once he returned to the outside world.
target: Statim postea, Lumian potentiam ex pacto suo cum Bloody Jack—Markl Speculi activavit. Volebat experiri utrum adhuc signum, quod in hoc spatio occulto relicum erat, postquam in mundum externum rediisset, sentire posset.

source: Blood seeped from his palm into the mirror, forming an inverted image.
target: Sanguis ex palma eius in speculum percola, imaginem invertam formans.

source: While waiting, Lumian suddenly had a thought: Did my recent encounters stack on negative effects from the Mirror Mark contract? This does indeed pertain to mirror‑related anomalies and bizarre dangers…
target: Dum exspectabat, Lumian subito cogitavit: Num nuper congressiones meae effectus negativos ex pacto Markl Speculi accumulaverint? Id certe spectat ad anomalias speculo pertinentes et ad pericula insólita…

source: In the blink of an eye, Lumian had set the Mirror Mark.
target: In ictu oculi, Lumian Markl Speculi instituit.

source: Having done this, he began to retrace his steps, avoiding areas where the silver full‑length mirror could reflect him, and walked up the wooden stairs.
target: Hoc factum, se revertere coepit, vitans loca ubi speculum argenteum totum eum reflectere posset, et scalas ligneas ascendit.

source: Before long, Lumian’s path brightened as he saw the wall lamps on either side of the ship’s cabin and the dim firelight.
target: Mox iter Lumiani illustratum est, cum vidisset lampades parietales utrinque cubiculorum navis atque lucem ignis tenui.

source: He had returned to the Blue Avenger.
target: Rediit ad Vindictorem Caeruleum.

source: Upon reaching the front deck, before Lumian could ask Madam Magician to retrieve the three items from his Traveler’s Bag and perform their appraisal, he heard the Major Arcana card holder chuckle and say, “As expected of a Hunter with the status of a fake Angel and Tudor’s remnant aura. You obtained three items closely related to Hunters and Demonesses in an instant.
target: Ad perveniens ad tabulatum prae navis, antequam Lumian Magistram Magicam rogarentem ut tres res ex sacculo Viatoris extraheret et earum aestimationem faceret, audivit tenentem cartam Major Arcana subridens atque dicentem: “Ut exspectabatur a Venatore cum statu Angelus ficti et aurae Tudoricae relictae. Tres res, arcte conexae Venatoribus et Daemonissis, statim obtinuisti.”

source: “That sword is what you were hoping for—it’s made from the Iron‑blooded Knight Beyonder characteristic.”
target: “Ille gladium est quod sperabas—ex charactere Beyonder Eques Sanguine Ferreo confectum.”
